dct_description_sm: This study aims to determine the impact of tylosin, live yeast, or autolyzed yeast supplementation on steer performance, feeding behaviour, total tract digestibility, rumen pH, and carcass characteristics of steers fed high-concentrate finishing diets containing monensin.
